notes: Every case is a new chart, the map registered afresh; animation false; a tooltip hides at once and sits at [5, 5].
A drag is mousemove and mousedown at the first point, a mousemove to each further one, mouseup and click at the last.
A wheel is zrender's mousewheel with wheelDelta = delta / 120.
After every step: chart._onframe() and a display-list refresh.
drawn: a path new in this state is its first canvas brush (double); one that was there before is the stored data replayed at the current scale (Float32 past 11 numbers).

cases.note: roam true: a left drag pans by the delta from the last point (one georoam per move, also off the canvas); the hovered region stays hovered and the tooltip up; the release then a click 40 px from the press is no click; a hover afterwards finds the regions where they went
the wheel: delta 120 is 1.1, 240 1.2, 480 1.4, the other way the inverse; about the pointer; a wheel off the map (outside containPoint) is not taken
scaleLimit {min 0.8, max 2}: the wheel stops at the limits (the zoom written back is the clamped one); zoom 3 in the option is clamped to 2 at the start
roam 'scale': a drag does nothing (no event), the wheel zooms; 'zoom' is the same word
roam 'move': the wheel does nothing, a drag pans; 'pan' is the same word; a right press does not arm
no roam on the geo nor at the root: no gesture; a written null at the geo climbs to the root, also nothing there
the geo's roam left out climbs to the root option (GeoModel has no roam default): root roam true makes it roam; one geo saying false does not

geoRoam by hand, roam off (an action is not gated by roam): by geoIndex a pan and a zoom about a point; componentType 'geo' with no query moves every geo; no geo key and no componentType is the map series' (nothing here, the event still fires); geoName; a pan with dy missing is no pan; geoIndex as an array
two geos side by side, both roaming: only the one under the pointer pans or zooms

two geos over each other: the higher z takes the gesture; on a tie the first geo (its controller was added first); a geo above with no roam makes the one under it irrelevant where its element is the top target (onIrrelevantElement) but not where the pointer is on nothing of it
states through a roam: hover A, a drag (A stays emphasised, the tooltip stays), a select by click, a wheel; a 3 px drag ends in a click (it selects), a 6 px one does not; focus 'self' blur survives

clip with a zoom: a press outside the view rect does not arm the first geo (isInClip), inside it does; the second geo, roamTrigger 'global' and no clip, takes whatever the first does not -- a wheel below the first's clip, a drag in a corner -- and loses a tie on the first's map

layoutCenter / layoutSize and boundingCoords with a percentage centre: the write-back keeps a percent half a percent (of the data rect) and a number half a number; preserveAspect cover on the second geo
after a roam a merge that leaves center and zoom alone keeps them; one writing zoom replaces the zoom and keeps the centre; one writing center replaces it; a resize keeps both; notMerge starts again
labels shown: they follow the regions and keep their size; a zoom far in draws the ring R out of more segments
